## Description and Rationale

Data Engineer based in Belgium, specializing in scalable data pipelines, ETL, and cloud architectures. Participating solo to manage the entire process from data prep to model evaluation.
I joined the PRC Data Challenge 2026 to solve a real-world aviation problem—predicting taxi-out times across 10 major European airports. Participating solo is a personal challenge to test my end-to-end data skills, build an efficient predictive pipeline under pressure, and compete with top industry talent.
